video_title: Charles Bassey reflects on Steph Curry's role in Warriors' OT win | NBC Sports Bay Area

quotes.speaker: Charles Bassey
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Bassey on Steph Curry's impact and gravity
quotes.excerpt: He's unbelievable, man. The three-point shot, the crowd he brings, he's different.

text_blocks.speaker: Reporter
text_blocks.text: Charles, what is your favorite part about playing with Steph Curry?

text_blocks.speaker: Charles Bassey
text_blocks.text: Man, you can see what he's doing, man. He's crazy. He's unbelievable, man. 41 points tonight. I don't know, but 41 points. Yeah, he's unbelievable, man. The three-point shot, the crowd he brings, he's different. He's different, man. I'm excited to play with him every time I'm out there on the floor. I'm still learning from him and everything. It's a joy to be a teammate of his.

quotes.speaker: Charles Bassey
quotes.summary_phrase: How Steph Curry's gravity creates opportunities for teammates
quotes.excerpt: He attracts so many players, man. He gets double-teamed every game.

text_blocks.speaker: Reporter
text_blocks.text: What does his gravity help open up for a center like you, those lanes?

text_blocks.speaker: Charles Bassey
text_blocks.text: It's a lot, man. You can see, man. He attracts so many players, man. He gets double-teamed every game. He definitely changes the game, making the bigs step up and stuff like that. So he's a different human when he's out there, man. It's fun playing with him because I know every time I'm out there and I screen for him, my man is wide open.

quotes.speaker: Charles Bassey
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Bassey on maintaining energy during close games
quotes.excerpt: I just felt like every time my name was called, I had one job to just go there.

text_blocks.speaker: Reporter
text_blocks.text: When you hear your number called, what are you thinking about the impact you want to make?

text_blocks.speaker: Charles Bassey
text_blocks.text: I just bring, you know, it was an up and down game for us today. We had the energy coming in, we were up like 20, 25, they came back to the game. They had the energy. We were just up and down, but I just felt like every time my name was called, I had one job to just go there and just bring the energy, you know, change the game, just do what I'm supposed to do out there, defense, offense, just excite the team, which I think I did that.

quotes.speaker: Charles Bassey
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors building rhythm during long home stand
quotes.excerpt: Steve trusts everybody on this team. He trusts each and every player on this team.

text_blocks.speaker: Reporter
text_blocks.text: This win streak coincides with a long home stand. What has it been like staying at home and building a rhythm together?

text_blocks.speaker: Charles Bassey
text_blocks.text: It's been great, man. That was what we had coming to the day. We were on the road, we were like three and one or something like that. So just coming in home, we felt like we could win every game and just continue to do what we do, you know, keep working out, watching film, getting better every game. And I think we're going to go back tomorrow, come back, watch the film and see what we did wrong and just continue to get better. And the coaches, like, Steve trusts everybody on this team. Like you said, even in overtime, the way he took Draymond and Steph out and then put me and the crew in, just the energy and stuff like that, you see he trusts each and every player on this team and it's good.
